SiromuKaM mAsyAyu pramozIriti” sU॰ । “kzuranimArjane'yaM viSezaH” vf॰ । “keSaSmaSrulomanaKAnyudaksaMsTAni saMpravyati” sU॰ । “SItozRABiradBirabarTaM kurvARo'kzuRvan kuSalI keSaSmaSrulomanaKAnyudaksaMsTAni kurviti nApitaSAsanam” nA॰ vf॰ । “kAlputya vAgyataH sTitvA'haHSezamAcAryasakASevAcaM visfjet varaM dadAmIti” sU॰ । “tata Alputya snAtvetyarTaH । vAgyata kaTamasya gomiTunasamBavaH ucyate yaTAsya prAvaraRAdi samBavastaTAsyApi” vf॰ । saMvatsaramAdiSet” sU॰ । evaM godAnaM kftvA saMvatsaraM vratamAdiSet vakzyamARena viDinA caret । rAtrO vratAdeSA'nupapatteH aparedyuH kAryyam” nA॰ vf॰ । etenetyanena cUqAvihitanakzatrAdigrahaRAtideSaH yaTAha mU॰ ci॰ “keSAntaM zoqaSe varze cOloktadivase SuBam” “zoqaSe varze cOloktadivase cUqAvarzatftIyAt praBavatItyAdinA kaTitaSuBadivase godAnaparyAyaM keSAnta saMjYaM karmma SuBaM syAt” gAvaH keSA dIyante KaRqyante yasminnitivyutpattiH yadAh “keSAntaM zoqaSe varze kuryAccOloktaBAdike” manuvacane tu saMskAraparatayA puMstvamiti boDyam । etasmAt pUrvaM mahAnABryAdivratatrayaM varzatraye karttavyaM tacca upanizacCabde sapramARaM darSitam । keSasyAntaH । 2 keSasva rUpe 3 keSAgre ca । lomasAmyAt prAdurBAvaH “zazWe balasya varRasya naKalomnAM ca samBavaH” yA॰ ukteH । janAnAM keSavattve kAraRam Sata॰ brAhmaRe uktaM tadvAkyaYca (keSin) Sabde vakzyate । keSanASakAraRaYca padAni pAdayoH” “vikIrRakeSAsu pareta BUmizu” kumA॰ “keSaH kASastavakavikASaH” sA॰ da॰ “keSezu camarIM hanti” si॰ kO॰ । “kluptakeSanaKaSmaSruH” manuH “keSaSmaSru GArayatAmagryA Bavati santatiH” Su॰ of Viṣṇu, L.

a: केशः — [क्लिश्यते क्लिश्नाति वा क्लिश्-अन् लो लोपश्च Uṇ. 5. 33] 1 Hair in general; विकीर्णकेशासु परेतभूमिषु Ku. 5. 68. --2 Especially, the hair of the head; केशेषु गृहीत्वा or केशग्राहं युध्यंते Sk.; मुक्तकेशा Ms. 7. 91; केशव्यपरोपणादिव R. 3. 56; 2. 8. --3 The mane of a horse or lion. --4 A ray of light. --5 An epithet of Varuṇa. --6 A kind of perfume. --7 An epithet of Viṣṇu. --शी 1 A lock of hair (on the crown of the head.) --2 An epithet of Durgā. --Comp. --अंतः {1} the tip of the hair. {2} long hair hanging down, a lock or tuft of hair. {3} cutting of the hair as a religious ceremony; Ms. 2. 65. --अंतिक a. {1} extending to the end of the hair as far as the forehead. {2} relating to the ceremony of final tonsure. --उच्चयः much or handsome hair. --कर्मन् n. dressing or arranging the hair (of the head) --कलापः a mass or quantity of hair. --कीटः a louse. --गर्भः {1} a braid of hair. {2} an epithet of Varuṇa. --गृहीत a. seized by the hair. --ग्रहः, --ग्रहणं pulling the hair, seizing (one) by the hair (both in amorous sports and in fighting); केशग्रहः खलु तदा द्रुपदात्मजायाः Ve. 3. 11, 29; Me. 50; so यत्र रतेषु केशग्रहाः K. 8 (that is, not in battles). --घ्न morbid baldness. --छिद m. a hairdresser, barber. --जाहं the root of the hair. --पक्षः, --पाशः, --हस्तः much (or ornamented) hair; तं केशपाशं प्रसमीक्ष्य कुर्युर्बालप्रियस्वं शिथिलं चमर्यः Ku. 1. 48; 7. 57; cf. कचपक्ष, कचहस्त &c. --बंधः a hair-band. --भूः, --भूमिः f. the head or any other part of the body on which hair grows. --प्रराधनी, --मार्जकं, --मार्जनं a comb. --रचना dressing the hair. --वेशः a tress or fillet of hair. --वेष्टः the parting of the hair.

a: केरलः — (pl.) 1 N. of a country (in the south of India, the modern Malabār) and its inhabitants; Māl. 6. 19; R. 4. 54. --ली A woman of the Kerala country. --2 Astronomical science. --3 A Hora or period of time equal to one hour.

केरल — The strip of land between the Western Ghats and the sea north of the Kāverī. The principal rivers in this tract are the Netravatī, the Śarāvatī and the Kālī-Nadī, which is considered to be the same as the Muralā referred to in R. 4. 55, and in U. 3, and forms the principal river of Kerala. Kerala corresponds to modern Kānarā, and probably included Malabar also, and extended beyond the kāverī.

gargaH । “anityodayacArARAmaSuBAnAYca darSanam । AgantUnAM sahasraM syAt grahARAM sanniboDa me” ॥ bahurUpamekameveti nAradAKyo munirekameva ketuM bahurUpaM prAha । tanmate eka eva ketustasya bahUni kAlAt praBftirityata Aha praTamAt pakzatrayAt parataH । sarvvezAM ketUnAM dinasAmyatvam । yAvanti dinAni dfSyaH ketustasmAddarSanAdUrdDvaM praTamaM pakzatrayaM paYcacatvAriMSaddinAni yAvat nizPalAni tasmAt pakzatrayAt parataH tAvato mAsAn PalapAkaH । aTa mAsAn dfSyate tadA tasmAdeva darSanAt parataH pakzattrayamatikramya mAsatulyAni varzARi vadet । praTamAt pakzatrayAt parataH tatra pakzattrayaM yAvaddinasaNKyA gfhyate । pakzattrayAdUrdDvaM yadA dfSyate ketustadA mAsatulyAni varzARi vadet । atra sandehavyudAsArTaM gargoktaM niyamakamaBiliKyate । taTA ca gargaH । “yAvantyahAni dfSyaH syAttAvanmAsAn PalaM Bavet । mAsAMstu yAvaddfSyeta tAvato'bdAMstu vEkftAn ॥ tripakzAt parataH karmma pacettasya SuBASuBam । yaddizwamudite ketO PalaM nehAdiSedbuDaH” ॥ taTA vfdDagargaH । “yAvato divasAMstizWettAvanmAsAn vinirdiSet । tripakzAt parataScApi karmma ketoH prapacyate ॥ tasmAt kAlAt paraM brUyAt Palamasya SuBASuBam । yaddizwamudaye ketoH PalaM nehAdiSedbuDaH” ॥ yadyevaM tadA dvitIyavyAKyAnamatra na Gawate praTamavyAKyAnameva jyAya iti । yaTA praTamAt pakzatrayAt parataH darSanAdUrdDvaM pakzatrayaM yAvannizPalaM pakzatrayAt parataH PalapAkasya kAlasaNKyA pravarttate tasmAduktaM yaddizwamudaye ketoH PalaM nehAdiSedbuDaH iti । yaduktaM mAsErabdAMSca vadet tadekadeSenApi pratimAsamekadvitridinadarSanena mAsasaNKyA laByata evetyarTaH । sarvvaTA kimanenAsmAkamasadvikalpena । divasEH pakzatrayAt parato mAsAn vadet । mAsEstasmAdeva pakzatrayAt parato'bdAn vadet । mAsAt parato dinADikyaM dfzwyanupAtavaSAt vAcyam । yaTA yadi dinatriMSatA varzaM laByate taddfzwyA dinEkena mAsEkamiti । taTA ca samAsasaMhitAyAm । “kecit ketusahasraM SatamekasamanvitaM vadantyeke । nAradamatameko'yaM trisTAnasamudBavo viviDarUpaH ॥ divyA graharkzajAtAstIvraPalakarA BOmAH । prARiDvajAdituNgezu cAntarIkzA na cAtyaSuBAH ॥ udayAstamayADUpanasaMyogAkAramArgadikpAtEH । PalAni divasErmmAsAn mAsEstu varzARi sandiSet ketoH” ॥ * ॥ aTa SuBasya ketorlakzaRamAha । “hrasvatanuH prasannaH snigDa fjuracirasaMsTitaH SuklaH । udito vApyaBidfzwaH suBikzasOKyAvahaH ketuH” ॥ fjurakuwilaH । acirasaMsTitaH SIGramevAdarSanaM yAti । SuklaH SvetaH । udito-vApyaBidfzwaH aTavodita evABidfzwastasmiMstu uditamAtre yadi dfzwirBavati tadA SuBaH । anyaTA aSuBaH ॥ aSuBasya ketorlakzaRamAha । “uktaviparItarUpo na SuBakaro DUmaketurutpannaH । indrAyuDAnukArI viSezato dvitricUlo vA” ॥ hrasvatanuH prasanna ityasmAduktAt yo viparItarUpaH keturutpannaH sa DUmaketuH । sa ca na SuBakaraH pApaM karotItyarTaH । indraDanuHsadfSo na SuBakara eva । taTA dviSiKastriSiKaSca viSezataH pApaPaladaH । taTA ca samAsasaMhitAyAm । “acirasTito'BidfzwastvajuH sitaH snigDamUrttirudaguditaH । hrasvatanuH prasannaH keturlokasya BavAya ॥ na SuBo viparIto viSezataH SakracApasaMkASaH । dvitricatuScUlo vA dakziRasaMsTaSca mftyukaraH” ॥ * ॥ aDunA ketusahasralakzaRaM vivakzustatrAdAveva ravijAH paYcaviMSatiH ketavo Bavanti । tezAM lakzaRamAha । “hAramaRihemarUpAH kiraRAKyAH paYcaviMSatiH saSiKAH । prAgaparadiSordfSyA nfpativiroDAvahA ravijAH” ॥ hAro muktAhAraH । maRayaScandrakAntapraBftayaH । hema suvarRam । tatsamAnavarRA ye ketavaste kiraRAKyAH kiraRasaMjYAH । saSiKAH sacUlAH । te ca paYcaviMSatI ravijAH sUryyasutAH prAgaparayoSca diSordfSyAH । prAk pUrvvasyAmaparasyAM paScimAyAM diSi dfSyante । etezAM maDyAdeka eva dfSyate na sarvve yugapaditi । sarvvatreyaM pariBAzA । te ca nfpate rAjYo viroDapradAH anizwA ityarTaH । taTA ca garga “SudDasPawikasaMkASA mfRAlarajatapraBAH ॥ muktAhArasuvarRABAH saSiKAH paYcaviMSatiH ॥ kiraRAKyA raveH puttrA dfSyante prAgdiSi sTitAH । taTA ca paraBAgasTA nfpatermayadASca te” ॥ * ॥ aTAgniputtrAstAvanta Aha । “SukadahanabanDujIvakalAkzAkzatajopamA hutASasutAH । AgneyyAM dfSyante tAvantaste'pi SiKino BayadAH” ॥ SukapakzI nIlapItavarRaH । dahano'gniH । banDujIvakaH puzpaviSezo'tilohitaH । lAkzA vfkzaniryAsaH । kzatajaM raktam । tadupamAstattulyavarRAH । te ca tAvantaH paYcaviMSatiH AgniyyAM diSi dfSyante । te ca hutASasutAH agniputtrAH agniBayadAH । taTA ca gargaH । “nAnAvarRAgnisaNkASA dIptimanto'pi cUlinaH । sfjantyagnimivAkASAt sarvvajyotizanASanAH ॥ te'gniputtrA grahA jYeyA loke'gniBayavedinaH । AgneyyAM diSi dfSyante paYcaviMSAH prakIrttitAH” ॥ aTa mftyusutAstAvanta evAha । “vakraSiKA mftyusutA rUkzAH kfzRASca te'pi tAvantaH । dfSyante yAmyAyAM janamarakAvedinaste ca” ॥ vakraSiKAH aspazwacUqAH । te ca rUkzA asnigDAste'pi paYcaviMSatireva । te ca mftyoH puttrA dakziRasyAM diSi dfSyante । te ca janAnAM marakaM Avedayanti । taTA ca gargaH ॥ “kfzRA rUkzA vakraSiKA wwaSyante yAmyadiksTitAH । paYcaviMSA mftyusutAH prajAkzayakarAH smftAH” ॥ aTa BUputtrA dvAviMSatirevAha । “darpaRavfttAkArA viSiKAH kiraRAnvitA DarAtanayAH । kzudBayadA dvAviMSatirESAnyAmambutElaniBAH” ॥ darpaRavat vfttaM varttulaM AkAro yezAM te viSiKA vicUlAH raSmisaMyuktAH BUmeH puttrAH । te ca dvAviMSatirESAnyAM dfSyante । jalasya tElasya ca sadfSakAntayaH । ete dfzwA durBikzaM dadati ॥ taTA ca gargaH । “samantavfttA viSiKA raSmiBiH parivAritAH । ambutElapratIkASA dvAviMSA BUsutAH smftAH । ESAnyAM diSi dfSyante durBikzaBayadASca te” ॥ * ॥ aTa candrasutAstraya Aha । “SaSikiraRahimarajatakumudakundakusumopamAH sutAH SaSinaH । uttarato dfSyante trayaH suBikzAvahAH SiKinaH” ॥ ete sOmyAyAM diSi dfSyante । te ca suBikzaM kurvvanti । taTA ca gargaH । “candraraSmisuvarRABA himakundendusupraBAH । trayaste SaSinaH puttrAH sOmyASAsTAH SuBAvahAH” ॥ aTa brahmadaRqAKyasya lakzaRamAha । “brahmasuta eka eva triSiKo varREstriBiryugAntakaraH । aniyatadikasaMpraBavo vijYeyo brahmadaRqAKyaH” ॥ brahmaputtra eka eva । sa ca tricUqaH । varREH sitAdimiScopalakzitaH । sa tu brahmadaRqasaMjYo jYeyaH । aniyatAyAM aniScitAyAM diSi saMpraBavaH utpadyate sarvvAsu dikzu dfSyata ityarTaH । sa tu yugasyAntaM karoti sarvvakzayakaraH ityarTaH । taTA ca gargaH । “eko brahmasutaH krUrastrivarRastriSiKAnvitaH । sarvvAsvASAsu dfSyaH syAt brahmadaRqaH kzayAvahaH” ॥ ekADikaM SataM kaTitaM anyAni navaSatAnyekonAni kaTanIyAni ityata Aha । “SatamaBihitamekasametamekADikAcCatAtparataH । ekonAni navaSatAni ketUnAM spazwErlakzaREH kaTayizye” ॥ SatamaBihitamekasametaM ekenADikaM ketUnAM SatamaBihitamuktam । tasmAdekADikAcCatAt parataH ekonAni ekena virahitAni navaSatAni ketUnAM spazwErvyaktErlakzaREScihnEH kaTayizye ॥ aTa SukraputtrAScaturaSItisaMjYAScAha । “SukrasutA visarpakAH sOmyESAnyorudayaM yAnti caturaSItyAKyAH । vipulasitatArakAste snigDASca Bavanti tIvraPalAH” ॥ sOmyA uttarA । ESAnI ISAnadik । tayorudayaM darSanaM gacCanti ! te ca vipulA vistIrRAH sitAH SuklAH tArakA yezAm । snigDA nirmmaladehAH te ca tIvraPalA anizwaPalA iti । taTA ca gargaH । “sTUlEkatArakAH SvetAH snehavantaSca supraBAH । arccizmantaH prasannASca tIvreRa ca suKAnvitAH ॥ ete visarpakA nAma SukraputtrAH purodayAH । aSItiScaturaScEva lokakzayakarAH smftAH” ॥ * ॥ aTa zazwiSanEScaraputtrAnAha । “snigDAH praBAsametA dviSiKAH zazwiH SanEScarANgaruhAH । atikazwaPalA dfSyAH sarvvatrEte kanakasaMjYAH” ॥ IdfSAHzazwiH SanEScaraputtrAH kanakaketavaH sarvvatra sarvvAsu dikzu dfzwAH atyaSuBaPalASca te । taTA ca gargaH । “susnigDA raSmisaMyuktA dviSiKAH sitatArakAH । zazWiste kanakA GorAH SanEScarasutA grahAH” ॥ * ॥ aTa gurusutAH paYcazazwirAha । “vikacA nAma gurusutAH sitEkatArAH SiKAparityaktAH । zazwipaYcaBiraDikAH snigDA yAmyASritAH pApAH” ॥ paYcazazwiH ketavo vikacA nAma vfhaspatiputtrAH । te ca sitaH SvetaH ekastArako yezAM cUqArahitAH । te ca dakziRasyAM dfSyante pApA anizwaPaladA ityarTaH । taTA ca gargaH । “snigDAH SuklAH prasannASca mahArUpAH praBAnvitAH । ekatArA vapuzmanto viSiKA raSmiBirvftAH ॥ ete vfhaspateH puttrAH prAyaSo dakziRASrayAH । nAmato vikacA GorAH paYcazazwirBayAvahAH” ॥ aTEkapaYca SadbuDaputtrAnAha । “nAtivyaktAH sUkzmA dIrGAH SuklA yaTezwadikpraBavAH । buDajAstaskarasaMjYAH pApaPalAstvekapaYcASat” ॥ taskaranAmAna ekapaYcASat ketavo buDasya puttrAH । nAtisPuwAH alpadehAH yaTezwAyAM diSi praBava utpattiryezAM sarvvAsu dikzu dfMSyanta ityarTaH । te cAnizwaPalAH । taTA ca gargaH । “arunDatisamA vyaktAH kecidavyaktatArakAH । pARquvarRAH sudIrGASca sUkzmA raSmiBirAvftAH ॥ ete buDAtmajA jYeyAstaskarAKyA BayAvahAH । ekADikAste paYcASadaTo'tyarTacarA grahAH” ॥ * ॥ aTa zazwiBOmaputtrAnAha । “kzatajAnalAnurUpAstricUlatArAH kujAtmajAH zazwiH । nAmnA ca kONkumAste sOmyASAsaMsTitAH pApAH” ॥ kONkumanAmAnaH zazwiketavo maNgalaputtrAH raktavahnisadfSAH lohitA ityarTaH । tricUlAstriSiKAstArA yezAM te ca uttarasyAM dfSyante pApaPalASca । taTA ca gargaH । “triSiKASca tritArASca raktalohitaraSmayaH । prAyaSastUttarAmASAM sevante nityameva te ॥ lohitANgAtmajA jYeyA grahAH zazwiH samAsataH । nAmataH kONkumA jYeyA rAjYAM saMgrAmakArakAH” ॥ * ॥ aTa trayastriMSadrAhuputtrAnAha । “triMSattu tryaDikA rAhoste tAmasakIlakA iti KyAtAH । raviSaSinA dfSyante tezAM PalamarkacAroktam” ॥ trayastriMSat svarBAnuputtrAste ca nAmataH tAmasakIlakA iti prasidDAH । te ca arkacandramaRqalasTA dfSyante tezAYca PalaM sUryyacAre kaTitaM tAmasakIlakasaMjYA rAhusutA iti । taTA ca gargaH । “kfzRABAH kfzRaparyyantAH saMkulAH kfzRaraSmayaH । rAhuputtrAstrayastriMSat kIlakAScAtidAruRAH ॥ ravimaRqalagAScEte dfSyante candragAstaTA” ॥ taTA ca parASaraH । “aparvvaRyeva dfSyante hyaNgirAH kAkakIlakAH । raverivANgirAmaDye hyuBayoH kAkakIlakO ॥ aNgirAH saraTo vApi dfSyate puruzAkftiH । kAkaH kAkAkftirGorastrikoRo vATa lakzyate ॥ maRqalaM kIlako maDye maRqalasyAsito grahaH । mahAnfpaviroDAya yasyarkzaM tasya mftyave” iti ॥ * ॥ aTa viMSatyaDikaM SatamagniputtrAnAha । “viMSatyaDikamanyacCatamagnervviSvarUpasaMjYAnAm । tIvrAnalaBayadAnAM jvAlAmAlAkulatanUnAm” ॥ anyat aparaM SataM viMSatyaDikaM ketUnAmagneH sutAnAM viSvarUpanAmnAM kIdfSAnAM jvAlAmAlABirAkulA vyAptAstanavo mUrttayo yezAm । taTA tIvraM GoramagniBayaM dadati । taTA ca gargaH । “nAnAvarRA hutASABA dIptimanto vicUlinaH । sfjantyagnimivAkASe sarvvajyotirvvinASanAH ॥ te'gniputtrA grahA jYeyA loke'gniBayavedinaH । viMSaM grahaSataM GoraM viSvarUpeti viSrutam” ॥ * ॥ aTa saptasaptativAyuputtrAnAha । “SyAvAruRA vitArAScAmararUpA vikIrRadIDitayaH । aruRAKyA vAyoH saptasaptatiH pApadAH paruzAH” ॥ aruRasaMjYA vAyoH puttrAH SyAvalohitavarRAH tArakavarjitAScAmararUpA vAlavyajanAkftayaH vyAkziptaraSmayaH rUkzAH duzwaPalapradAH । atra yezAM diNniyamo nAsti te'niyatadarSanAH sarvvAsvapi dikzu dfSyante । taTA ca gargaH । “atArarUpapratimAH SyAvaraktasuvarRinaH । vAlarUpA ivABAnti SuklavistIrRaraSmayaH ॥ saptasaptati cEvAnye vAyoH puttrAH pracakzate । lokaviDvaMsanA vfkzA nAmatastvaruRA grahAH” ॥ * ॥ aTAzwO prajApatisutA dve ca Sate caturaDike brahmaRaH puttrAstAnAha । “tArApuYjanikASA gaRakA nAma prajApaterazwO । dve ca Sate caturaDike caturasrA brahmasantAnAH ॥ azwO ketavo gaRakA nAma prajApateH puttrAH” । te ca tArARAM nakzatrARAM puYjaH samUhastadAkArAH । te ca aSuBadAyinaH । taTA ca । dve Sate caturaDike ketUnAM te ca caturasrasaMjYAH caturAkftayaste ca brahmaRaH puttrAH pApaPalA eva jYeyAH te cAgneyadigBavAH । taTA ca gargaH । “tArApuYjapratIkASA vyomamaRqalasaMsTitAH । prAjApatyA grahAstvazwO gaRakA BayavedinaH ॥ tryasrASca caturasrA vA saSiKAH SvetaraSmayaH । dve Sate caturaScEva brahmajA BayadASca te” ॥ * ॥ aTa dvAtriMSadvaruRaputtrAnAha । “kaNkA nAma varuRajA dvAtriMSat gulmasaMsTAnAH । SaSivatpraBAsametAstIvraPalAH ketavaH proktAH” ॥ te varuRaputtrAH vaMSagulmavat saMsTAnamAkftiryezAM । gulma ekamUlajo latAsamUhaH । SaSivat candravat praBayA kAntyA sametAste ca tIvraPalAH kazwaPalAH proktAH kaTitAste cAniyatadikpraBavAH । taTA ca gargaH । “vaMSagulmapratIkASA mahAntaH pUrRaraSmayaH । kAkatuRqaniBEScABi raSmiBiH kecidAvftAH ॥ mayUKAnunmfjantIva snigDatvAt sOmyadarSanAH । ete kazwaPalAH kaNkA dvAtriMSadvAruRA grahAH” ॥ * ॥ aTa zaRRavatikAlaputtrAnAha । “zaRRavatiH kAlasUtAH kabanDasaMjYAH kabanDasaMsTAnAH । puRqrA'BayapradAH syurvvirUpatArAste SiKinaH” ॥ kAlaputtrAH kabanDasaMsTAnAH zaRRavatiH । kabanDaSCinnaSiraHpuruzastadvat saMsTAnamAkftiryezAM te ca virUpA asPuwAstArakA yezAM te SiKinaH ketavaH puRqA nAma janapadAstezAM SreyaskarAH syuH । anyatra punarBayadAste cAniyatadikasaMpraBavAH । taTA ca gargaH । “tArApuYjavirUpASca kabanDAkftisaMsTitAH । pItAruRAH savarRASca BasmakarpUraraSmayaH ॥ kAlaputtrAH kabanDASca nabatiH zaw prakIrttitAH । lokarogakarA GorAH puRqrARAmaBayapradAH” ॥ * ॥ aTa navavidikputtrAH sarvvezAYca saMKyAmanyezAYca vakzyAmItyetadAha । “SuklavipulEkatArA navavidiSAM ketavaH samutpannAH । evaM ketusahasraM viSezamezAmato vakzye” ॥ vidiSAM digantarARAYca nava ketavaH samutpannAH vidikputtrA ityarTaH । kimBUtAH SuklaH SvetavarRo vipulo vistIrRa ekatAro yezAM te vidikketavo dfSyante dfzwASca pApaPalAH । taTA ca gargaH । “SuklEkatArA vipulA vidikputtrA navagrahAH । vidikzu saMsTitA eva dfSyante BayadAyakAH” ॥ evaM ketusahasramiti । evaM ketUnAM sahasraM uktaM ezAmeva viSezalakzaRaM vakzye । ezAM maDyAt kecit dfSyante na sarvva eva । tatra ye dfSyante tezAM lakzaRaM vaktukAmastatrAdAveva ketorlakzaRamAha ॥ * ॥ “udagAyato mahAn snigDamUrttiraparodayI vasA ketuH । sadyaH karoti marakaM suBikzamapyuttamaM kurute” ॥ udagAyata uttarasyAM diSyAyato dIrGaH mahAnatisTUlaH nirmmalatanuH aparodayI paScimAyAM diSyudayaM yAti । sa ca nAmnA vasAketurdfzwaH sadya eva tasminnahani maraRaM karoti । uttamamapi praDAnaM suBikzaYca kurute ॥ * ॥ aTAsTiketoH SastrAKyasya ca lakzaRamAha । “tallakzaRo'sTiketuH sa tu rUkzaH kzudBayAvahaH proktaH snigDastAdfk prAcyAM SastrAKyo qamaramarakAya” ॥ tadityanena vasAketoH parAmarSaH । asTiketuSca tallakzaRErvasAketusadfSEryuktaH । udagAyata ityAdi kintvayaM viSezaH sa tu rUkzaH sneharahitaH dfzwaSca kzudBayAvahaH kaTitaH । snigDastAdfgiti tAdfgvasAketusadfSo'nyaH snigDo nirmmaladehaH prAcyAM dfSyate । sa tu SastranAmA ketardfzwaH qamaraM SastrakalahaM marakaYca karoti । taTA ca parASaraH । “eBiH zaqviMSatirudayEH PalamAvedayanti । tannAmato rUpataH PalataH kAlato'BiDAsyAmaH” ॥ tatra mArttivAstraya udayaM yAnti । ekEkaSo vasAsTiSastraketurvvA । tatra vasAketuH snigDo mahAnudagAyataSiKastriMSadvarzaSataM prozya saMplave yuge paScimoditaH sadyo marakaPalaH sOBikzakaraH rUkzo'sTiketuH sOBikzakarastulyapravAsakAlaPalaH pUrvveRa snigDa eva SastraketUrAjaviroDamarakaPalaH samodayaH ॥ * ॥ aTa kapAlaketorlakzaRamAha । “dfSyo'mAvAsyAyAM kapAlaketuH saDUmraraSmiSiKaH । prANnaBaso'rdDavicArI kzunmarakAvfzwirogakaraH” ॥ kapAlaketurnAma amAvasyAyAM dfSyate pUrvvadiSi udyaM yAti । kIdfSaH saDUmrA raSmiSiKA yasya kiraRakAntirDUmravarRetyarTaH । naBasa AkASasya ardDaM yAvadvicarati । sa ca durBikzamarakAvarzaRarogapradaH । taTA ca parASaraH । “aTAdityajAnAM kapAlaketurudayate amAvAsyAyAM pUrvvasyAM diSi saDUmrArcciSiKo naBaso vizayArdDacaro dfSyate । paYcaviMSavarzaSataM prozya trIMSca pakzAn sftiryasya kumudaketoScArAnte sa dfzwa eva । durBikzAnAvfzwivyADiBayaM pratyupadravAn sfjati । yAvato divasAn dfSyate tAvanmAsAnmAsEH saMvatsarAn paYcaprasTaM varzADAnyasyArGyaM kftvA prajAnAmekamupayuNkte” ॥ aTa rOdraketorlakzaRamAha । “prAgvESvAnaramArge SUlAgraH SyAvarUkzatAmrArcciH । naBasastriBAgagAmI rOdra iti kapAlatulyaPalaH” ॥ rOdranAmA ketuH pUrvvasyAM diSi vESvAnaramArge dahanavITyAM dfSyate । pUrvvAzAQottarAzAQayoH samIpa ityarTaH । kIdfSaH SUlAgraH SUlAkftiragraM yasya ketoH sa SUlAgraH triSiKa ityarTaH । tasyEva viSezaRaM SyAvarUkzatAmrArcciH SyAvarUkzaM tAmraM cArccistejo yasya sa SyAvarUkzatAmrArcciH । naBasa AkASasya triBAgagamanaSIlaH । sa ca kapAlaketoH samaPalaH । etaduktaM Bavati kzunmarakAvfzwirogakft । AcAryyeRa SukrAcAre vESvAnaramArgaH pradarSita eva AzAQAdvayaM dahana iti । taTA ca parASaraH । “aTa dakzayajYe rudrakroDodBavaH kAlaketustrIRi varzaSatAni nava ca mAsAn prozya udayate । pUrvveRa calaketuH SiKayA yAmyAgrayANgulocCritayA । gacCet yaTodak taTA tayA dErGyamAyAti ॥ saptamunIn saMspfSya DruvamaBijitameva pratinivfttaH syAt । naBaso'rdDaBAgamitvA yAmyenAsta samupayAti ॥ hanyAt prayAgakUlAt yAvadavantIYca puzkarAraRyam । udagapi ca devikAmapi BUyizWaM maDyadeSAKyam ॥ anyAnapi ca sa deSAn kvacit kvacidDanti rogadurBikzEH । daSa mAsAn PalapAko 'sya kEScidazwAdaSa proktaH” ॥ aparasyAmiti paSciyAmAM diSi calaketunAmA keturdfSyate । sa ca kIdfSaH yAmyAyAM diSi agraM yasyAH tayA aNgulapramARocCritayA yaTA yena prakAreRa udaka uttarasyAM diSi yAti taTA tenEva prakAreRa dErGyaM dIrGatAM prApnoti । saptamunIt vaSizWAdIn saMspfSya taTA DruvaM DruvatArakaM aBijitaYca nakzatraM saMspfSya tataH pratinivfttaH pratyAgataH naBasa AkASasya ardDaBAgamitvA gatvA prApya yAmyena aTADikaM dfSyate kanAmA yaH । daSavarzARyupatApaM janayati SastraprakopakftaM ॥ prAgardDarAtradfSya iti । SvetaketunAmA ketuH prAk pUrvvasyAM diSi ardDarAtrakAle dfSyate yAmyAgro dakziRaSiKaH anyaSca dvitIyaH ka iti kanAmA keturapare paScimAyAM diSi dfSyate । yugAkftiH yugasaMsTAnAkAraH tO dvAvapi yugapattulyakAlaM sapta divasAn dfSyete । tO ca dvAvapi snigDAvati nirmmalO dfSyO ca suBikzaSivadO । aTa yaH kanAmA sa yadi saptaByo'DikaM dfSyate tadA SastraprakopajaM saMgrAmajamupatApaM janayati । taTA ca parASaraH । “aToddAlakaH SvetaketurddaSottaraM varzaSataM prozya BawaketoScArAnte pUrvvasyAM dakziRABinataSiKo'rdDarAtrakAle dfSyastenEva saha dvitIyaH kaH prajApatiputtraH । paScimakena gfhaketuryUpasaMsTAyIyugapaddfSyeta । tatastAvumO saptarAtradfSyO daSavarzARi prajAH pIqayete । kaH viyattriBAgagatiH । vinivarttate'pasavyaM triBAgaSezAH prajAH kurute” ॥ SvetanAmA ketuH jawAkAro jawAsadfSaH SyAvaH kfzRavarRaH viyatyAkASe triBAgaM yAvadgacCati tato'pasavyaM pradakziRaM vAmaBAge । “ADUmrayAtiSiKayA darSanamAyAti kfttikAsaMsTaH । jYeyaH sa raSmiketuH SvetasamAnaM PalaM Datte” ॥ yaH keturADUmravarRayA SiKayopalakzitastaTA kfttikAsaMsTaH kavikAnAM samIpe darSanaM gacCati sa “DruvaketuraniyatagatiH pramARAkftirBavati । viSvak divyAntarIkzaBOmo BavatyayaM snigDa izwaPalaH ॥ senANgezu nfpARAM gfhataruSElezu cApi deSAnAm । gfhiRAmupaskarezu ca vinASinAM darSanaM yAti” ॥ Druveti । aniyatA aniScitA gatirgamanaM pramARaM sTUlasUkzmamaDyaBAvamAkftiH AkAro yasya sa taTABUtaH । sa ca viSvak samantato Bavati sarvvAsu dikzvityarTaH । sa ca divyAntarIkzaBOmastriviDo Bavati । a: केवल — a. [केव् सेवने वृषा˚ कल्] 1 Peculiar, exclusive, uncommon; Pt. 2. 134. --2 Alone, more, sole, only, isolated; स हितस्य न केवलां श्रियं प्रतिपेदे सकलान् गुणानपि R. 8. 5; न केवलानां पयसां प्रसूतिमवेहि मां कामदुघा प्रसन्नां 2. 63; 15. 1; Ku. 2. 34. --3 Whole, entire, absolute, perfect. --4 Bare, uncovered (as ground); Ku. 5. 12. --5 Pure, simple, unmingled, unattended (by anything else); कातर्यं केवला नीतिः R. 17. 47. --6 Selfish, envious. --ली, --लं The doctrine of absolute unity of spirit and matter. --ली Astronomical science. --लं ind. Only, merely, solely, entirely, absolutely, wholly; केवलमिदमेव पृच्छामि K. 155; न केवलं-जपि not only-but; वसु तस्य विभोर्न केवलं गुणवत्तापि परप्रयोजना R. 8. 31; cf. also 3. 19, 20, 31. --Comp. --अन्वयिन् see under अन्वय. --आत्मन् a. one whose essence is absolute unity; Ku. 2. 4. --ज्ञानिन् m. the first Arhat. --द्रव्यं black pepper. --ज्ञानं highest Knowledge; Pt. 5. 12. --नैयायिकः a mere logician (not proficient in any other branch of learning); so ˚वैयाकरण.
